name: effective_cache_size
description: Estimate of total disk cache available for PostgreSQL data files, including OS kernel cache and PostgreSQL shared buffers; used by the query planner to choose between index and sequential scans.
symptoms: Suboptimal query plans (e.g., unnecessary seq scans)
Poor index usage despite selective predicates
Higher-than-expected query latency for cached workloads
tuning_tips: Set to 50–70% of total RAM on dedicated PostgreSQL servers; on shared servers, subtract estimated memory used by shared_buffers, work_mem, and other processes before allocating. Never set higher than actual combined cache capacity.
